title: Nested points of the Hilbert functor are equal
statement: Let $X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $d\ge0$, let $T$ be an $S$-scheme and let $Z\subseteq Z'\subseteq X_T$ be closed subschemes of the base change $X_T$ [def-pc-base-change] such that both $Z\to T$ and $Z'\to T$ are finite locally free of degree $d$ [def-pc-finite-locally-free], i.e. $Z,Z'\in\operatorname{Hilb}^d_{X/S}(T)$ [def-pc-hilb-functor]. Then $Z=Z'$.
